shortDescription: Request reload of Memset's DNS infrastructure,

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

options.name: poll
options.description: If V(true), it polls the reload job's status and return when the job has completed (unless the 30 second timeout is reached first). If the timeout is reached then the task does not return as failed, but stderr indicates that the polling failed.
